meta.description: Registry for functional-form related failure modes and collapsing risks in Phase 3.

failure_modes.name: collapsed_multi_valued_delta
failure_modes.description: Symbolic form incorrectly forces delta into a unique, deterministic result.

failure_modes.name: assumed_navt_invertibility
failure_modes.description: Functional form for NavT allows for unique preimage recovery without satisfying formal constraints.

failure_modes.name: universal_residue_conservation_assertion
failure_modes.description: Symbolic rule for residue_update forbids dissipation or saturation alternatives.

failure_modes.name: hidden_degenerate_minima
failure_modes.description: Orientation minimization form fails to account for or represent tied candidates.

failure_modes.name: unstable_composition_form
failure_modes.description: The composite form of two operators results in a symbolic state that violates its declared codomain.

failure_modes.name: undefined_functional_term
failure_modes.description: Candidate expression references a sub-function or variable with no formal registration.

failure_modes.name: boundary_collapse_in_equation
failure_modes.description: Symbolic form becomes degenerate or null at critical process boundaries (e.g. epsilon = 0).
